text:
Type: three-drawer textured chest
Use: storing clothes; bedroom, living room
Style: mid-century modern, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: carved diamond-pattern light wood drawer fronts, dark grey wood case, brass bar pulls, brass hairpin legs
Colors: light natural wood, dark grey-brown, brass
Shape: boxy chest, three drawers with faceted pyramid relief, slim long pulls, splayed thin metal legs, raised and medium in size
Feel: textured, eclectic, warm
Goes with: white walls, brass, rattan and plants; boho or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Chest of Drawers with Diamond Pattern, 17.7 Inch Width, Natural
product.description: The diamond-pattern woodwork in this solid-hardwood cabinet gives it a bold, modern look. Gold metal legs and drawer pulls complement the natural warmth of the birch, and the smooth ball-bearing drawer glides make storage easy. 36.38"W x 17.7"D x 31.5"H Solid hardwood cabinet with birch ply concave diamond designs in drawer fronts; gold metal legs and drawer pulls The clean styling and diamond pattern woodwork on drawer fronts give this a modern look. The three drawers are great to hide away items like clothes, table linens, and even board games. This piece features ball-bearing drawer glides. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
